How it works

The complete 10-step rental journey

From first search to final settlement, every rental follows the same clear, accountable path.

  1. 1

    Discovery

    Tell us about your project; we recommend the right equipment.

  2. 2

    Selection

    Choose from a wide range of verified, high-performance machines.

  3. 3

    Booking

    Pick dates and confirm availability for your equipment.

  4. 4

    Payment

    Secure your booking with flexible, escrow-backed payment.

  5. 5

    Approval

    We verify details and approve the booking, getting you ready to go.

  6. 6

    Inspection & logistics

    Equipment is inspected, dispatched and delivered safely, on time.

  7. 7

    Management

    Track, monitor and manage your rental with real-time support.

  8. 8

    Extension

    Need more time? Extend your rental in a few taps.

  9. 9

    Return inspection

    We inspect on return to ensure quality, safety and fair usage.

  10. 10

    Settlement

    Final billing is processed with clarity and fairness.

Platform highlights

Everything you need to rent with confidence

Built for contractors and fleet owners alike: verified machines, transparent pricing and secure payments in one place.

Smart equipment search

Find the right machine fast with advanced filters and verification-ranked results.

Verified & trusted

Every listing is checked for quality, compliance and reliability before it goes live.

Transparent pricing

Clear daily rates with deposits, delivery and escrow holds itemised. No surprises.

Real-time availability

Seamless communication
